description: Find which institutional managers reported holding an issuer, by searching 13F-HR information tables for one reporting quarter. This is the reverse direction of secedgar_get_institutional_holdings: that tool takes a manager and returns its portfolio, this one takes an issuer and returns its managers — pass a returned filer_cik plus the same quarter to read the actual position. Searching by cusip is the precise path, matching the identifier the information table itself carries; without it the issuer name is matched as a phrase against the filing text, which both over-matches (unrelated issuers sharing a word) and under-matches (managers writing the name differently), so prefer cusip whenever one is known. A CUSIP cannot be derived from a ticker here — read one off any 13F information table returned by secedgar_get_institutional_holdings. The returned list is unranked: the search index scores by text relevance, which carries no signal about position size, and no ordering by shares or market value is available without opening each filing. Managers holding under $100M in 13(f) securities are exempt from filing at all. When more managers match than fit inline, the full fetched set is staged as df_<id> — inspect it with secedgar_dataframe_describe, then analyze it with secedgar_dataframe_query.

cusip.description: The issuer's 9-character CUSIP (e.g. "037833100" for Apple common stock; foreign issuers use a CINS starting with a letter, e.g. "H1467J104"). The precise match key — information tables identify every position by CUSIP, so this avoids the name-phrase misses. Each share class has its own CUSIP, so a multi-class issuer needs one call per class. Read a CUSIP off the holdings returned by secedgar_get_institutional_holdings.

issuer.description: The portfolio company whose holders you want — a ticker ("AAPL"), a 10-digit CIK ("0000320193"), or a company name. Without cusip, this resolves to the company's EDGAR-conformed name and that name is phrase-matched against 13F information tables, so it must identify one company. With cusip supplied, it is used only to label the result.

limit.description: Filer rows returned inline. The full fetched set (up to 500 rows) is materialized as a dataframe when a canvas is available. Default 20. Capped at 100: a larger value, up to 1000, returns what 100 returns.

quarter.description: Reporting quarter to search, "YYYY-QN" (e.g. "2026-Q1"). Omit for the newest quarter whose 45-day filing deadline has passed — the applied quarter and its filing window are echoed in the response. A quarter still inside its deadline returns only the managers that filed early, so its set is incomplete until the deadline passes.

name: secedgar_find_holders

dataset.description: Fetched managers keyed by issuer and quarter for joins. Absent if inline fits, canvas is unavailable or staging fails.

name.description: Dataframe handle (df_XXXXX_XXXXX) for secedgar_dataframe_describe, then secedgar_dataframe_query.

truncated.description: True when the fetched sample may omit matching documents.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `issuer_not_found`: No cusip was given and the issuer does not resolve to a known EDGAR company. `ambiguous_issuer`: The issuer name matches several EDGAR companies and no cusip was given. `rate_limited`: SEC is rate-limiting this server's IP — SEC answered 429, or the call was refused without being sent while the cool-down after one runs. `sec_unreachable`: SEC EDGAR gave no complete, readable response — on the last attempt made (the third, or an earlier one once this call's 40-second budget for SEC failures ran out) the connection failed, no response headers arrived within 15 seconds, or the body broke off or stalled for 15 seconds, each wait capped at what was left of that budget; a 200 body was not the JSON SEC serves; or earlier SEC failures had spent that budget, so the request was never sent. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

fetched.description: Filings retrieved, at most 500; equals total_filings when the window fit.

filed_from.description: Start of the filing window searched (YYYY-MM-DD).

filed_to.description: End of the filing window searched (YYYY-MM-DD).

holders.description: One page of filers, capped at limit; order says nothing about position size.

items.description: One institutional manager reporting a position in this issuer.

accession_number.description: Accession number of the 13F-HR — pass to secedgar_get_filing.

filer_cik.description: Filer CIK, zero-padded to 10 digits; pass as company to secedgar_get_institutional_holdings.

filer_name.description: Institutional manager that filed, ticker/CIK parentheticals stripped.

form.description: "13F-HR", or "13F-HR/A" for an amendment. Absent when the index carries no form tag.

holders_in_quarter.description: Distinct in-quarter managers in the fetched sample and dataframe; latest filing per CIK wins, other periods excluded.

notice.description: Continuation, search coverage, empty results, and dataframe guidance.

ordering.description: How the holder list is ordered, and what that ordering does not mean.

quarter.description: Reporting quarter searched, "YYYY-QN": the requested one or the default.

resolved_issuer_cik.description: CIK of the resolved issuer, zero-padded to 10 digits. Absent when cusip was supplied.

resolved_issuer_name.description: EDGAR-conformed name the issuer resolved to, also the phrase searched. Absent when cusip was supplied.

search_key.description: The exact term searched — the CUSIP, or the quoted phrase.

search_mode.description: "cusip" matches the information table's identifier; "name" phrase-matches filing text, looser both ways.

total_filings.description: Matching documents in the filing window, including amendments; holders_in_quarter deduplicates managers and filters period.

total_is_exact.description: False when total_filings is a lower bound (the index capped the count).

truncated.description: True when the inline holders list was capped.

title: Find Holders
